Details  
 Designed for effortless western style with a modern edge, this women’s western cropped tee blends clean design with everyday ranch-inspired attitude, making it an easy staple for spring and summer styling.
 Made from 100% ring-spun cotton and pigment washed for a soft, lived-in feel, the Uncomplicated Cropped Tee delivers comfort from the first wear. The boxy cropped silhouette pairs perfectly with high-rise denim, especially styles from the Kimes Ranch women’s jeans collection, creating a balanced, flattering cowgirl look.
 Easy to layer, easy to style, and true to western roots, this cropped tee keeps things simple without sacrificing character.
 Fabric: 100% Ring Spun Cotton
 Fit: Women's Cropped, Boxy Fit
 Details: Soft hand print, pigment washed
